title: Repair the first message
prompt: The program should print Ready on one line and Open on the next. The starter does not compile, and its first message has a spelling mistake. Read the compiler error, repair the line it names, then fix the text.
hints: The error names a line and says what the compiler expected there.
Every statement ends with a semicolon. Add the missing one, then save again.
Once it compiles, compare the first printed line with the word Ready, letter by letter.
checkLabels: The output must be Ready, then Open, on two lines.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Fixes the compiler error but leaves the misspelled text.
Prints the two lines in the wrong order.

feedback: Compare your output with the prompt one character at a time. Spelling, capital letters and line order all count.
